mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NRECENTSRCHWRD ( SRCHWRD_MANAGE_ID, RECENT_SRCHWRD_ID, RECENT_SRCHWRD_NM, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID )VALUES( #{srchwrdManageId}, #{srchwrdId}, #{srchwrdNm}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId}, NOW(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT A.RECENT_SRCHWRD_NM, COUNT(A.RECENT_SRCHWRD_ID) RECENT_SRCHWRD_CO FROM NRECENTSRCHWRD A WHERE 1=1
AND A.SRCHWRD_MANAGE_ID = #{srchwrdManageId} AND A.RECENT_SRCHWRD_NM LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{q},'%') GROUP BY A.RECENT_SRCHWRD_NM ORDER BY RECENT_SRCHWRD_CO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NRECENTSRCHWRD ( SRCHWRD_MANAGE_ID, RECENT_SRCHWRD_ID, RECENT_SRCHWRD_NM, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID )VALUES( #{srchwrdManageId}, #{srchwrdId}, #{srchwrdNm}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId}, NOW(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM NRECENTSRCHWRD WHERE 1=1 AND SRCHWRD_MANAGE_ID=#{srchwrdManageId}
AND RECENT_SRCHWRD_NM LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{searchKeyword},'%')

SELECT A.SRCHWRD_MANAGE_ID, A.SRCHWRD_MANAGE_NM, A.SRCHWRD_CONECT_URL SRCHWRD_MANAGE_URL, A.USER_SEARCH_AT, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID, TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYY-mm-dd') FRST_REGISTER_PNTTM, (SELECT USER_NM FROM COMVNUSERMASTER WHERE ESNTL_ID = A.FRST_REGISTER_ID) FRST_REGISTER_NM FROM NRECENTSRCHWRDMANAGE A WHERE 1=1
AND SRCHWRD_MANAGE_NM LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{searchKeyword},'%')
AND SRCHWRD_CONECT_URL LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{searchKeyword},'%')
ORDER BY A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
